summary: Chanson International Holding filed a Form 6-K reporting that CFO Jihong Cai resigned effective June 26, 2026 due to other commitments, with no disagreements. The board immediately appointed Gang Liu as CFO; Liu has over 30 years of accounting/finance experience, most recently as Finance Department Director at Kashgar Urban Construction Investment Company. The company entered into standard employment and indemnification agreements. No deal terms are involved. Watch for further management stability or additional changes as the company navigates its U.S. listing obligations and Chinese operations.
